title: SwiftMon Redux
description: A Cobblemon pack that doesn't stray to far away from the vanilla experience.
body:
SwiftMon is a high-performance Minecraft modpack that blends the thrilling world of Cobblemon with the exploration and depth of Vanilla+ mods. Catch, train, and battle Pokémon—including Megas and Legendaries—in an enhanced Minecraft survival world that feels alive, rich, and endless in possibility.

Key Features

Cobblemon Core – Experience the pixel-perfect Pokémon mod that brings battles, evolutions, and wild encounters into Minecraft.

Megas & Legendaries – Seek out rare legendary spawns and mega evolutions! With special forms and enhanced mechanics, every battle counts.

Swift-Paced Progression – Balanced for smooth solo or multiplayer play with streamlined configs and enhanced wild Pokémon variety.

Vanilla+ World – Explore a refined survival world with mods that enhance the base game: better structures, improved terrain, QOL tools, and more immersive biomes.

Custom Spawns & Events – Dynamic legendary events, unique item drops, and SwiftMon-exclusive tweaks to make your world feel truly alive.

Multiplayer Ready – Balanced for server play with performance optimizations, anti-lag tweaks, and a competitive-friendly environment.
